title: Full Base & Housing System
objective: Build the complete base and housing vertical over existing MIB-14 foundations without duplicating inventory, economy or world truth.

scope.purpose: Build the complete base/housing vertical over MIB-14 foundations.
scope.completion_gate: A base can be created, operated, modified and recovered through complete Player/GM workflows without duplicating inventory/economy/world truth.

selection_boundaries: SMB-04 is completed_verified before SMB-05 implementation.
SMB-05 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.
MIB-14 remains base/platform/facility configuration, compatibility, capacity, storage/workstation and maintenance/upgrade planning authority; SMB-05 composes those seams rather than replacing them.
D17 remains live Asset identity, ownership, inventory, storage placement, condition and state authority; SMB-05 may only consume snapshots and committed owner-result references.

MIB-12 remains crafting/recipe authority, MIB-13 remains economy/price/settlement authority, APW-03/D26 remain long-running Project/Activity and campaign-time authority, and MIB-11/D18 remain world/location authority.

CEL-03 and other completed production/hospitality/resource surfaces remain projection/composition authorities; SMB-05 may reference their results but may not create a second production, resource or economy ledger.
Player/GM operation must depend on existing authorization/control-grant evidence and may not infer control from ownership, possession, crew assignment or UI selection.
Defense outcomes remain with existing combat/strategic owner domains; SMB-05 may expose capability and result references only.
No autonomous upkeep/production scheduler, wall-clock progress, universal construction cost/yield formula, provider activation, public/tester distribution or migration is authorized.
Implementation must establish a failing acceptance seam before production code and pass exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation plus MIB-14/CEL-03 predecessor invariants.
SMB-06 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-05 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.

implementation_plan.name: RED acceptance seam
implementation_plan.deliverable: A focused acceptance profile that fails because the bounded SMB-05 base lifecycle module does not yet exist.

implementation_plan.name: Derived base lifecycle contract
implementation_plan.deliverable: Deterministic base plan/projection/replay covering creation, operation, modification, interruption/damage, recovery, storage/facility/workforce/production/defense/utility references and maintenance/upgrade project references while live mutation stays owner-domain committed.

implementation_plan.name: Source-governance proof
implementation_plan.deliverable: Machine-checkable proof that SMB-05 reuses MIB-14/D17/MIB-12/MIB-13/APW-03/D26/MIB-11/D18/CEL-03 and existing control/combat authorities without parallel ledgers, autonomous progress or invented formulas.

implementation_plan.name: Exact-head verification and closeout
implementation_plan.deliverable: Linux and Windows focused acceptance, source-governance invariants, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform receipts pass on one exact head before merge; then OPS3 records SMB-05 completed_verified and selects SMB-06 without starting it.

next_action: Create the SMB-05 RED acceptance test/profile on work/smb-05-full-base-housing, prove expected failure, then implement only the minimum deterministic base lifecycle projection/replay over MIB-14 and canonical owner references needed to satisfy the completion gate.
